correctness.rationale: Independently integrating inverse-Rayleigh density gives F_X(x)=exp(-theta/x^2); conditioning on Y~Beta(q,1) gives the exact survival 1-exp(-a)+a^{q/2}Gamma(1-q/2,a), a=theta/z^2. For q=2+2w/L, L=log(1/a), eta=w/L, singular integral on [a,1] is exactly L Phi(w). The analytic remainder R(eta) has R(0)=-EulerGamma and uniform bounded derivative near zero; its lower cutoff produces only O(a), yielding S=a[L Phi(w)+1-EulerGamma exp(-w)+O_K(1/L)]. With q_n=2+2kappa/log n and b_n=sqrt(theta n log n), expansion of L=log n+log log n+2log x yields the stated two-term nS, the Fréchet-type limit exp(-Phi(kappa)/x^2), and bounded compact uniform error. Independent 60-digit incomplete-gamma calculation at z=10^22 and w=-1,0,1 checked scaled two-term remainders 0.0263, 3.4e-19, 0.00362 respectively; finite values corroborate analytic estimates.
residual_risks: One primary-paper printed CDF expression appears inconsistent with its own density; proof uses the normalized density and correctly integrated F_X=exp(-theta/x^2). Uniformity only |w| bounded and x on compact subsets of (0,infty).
